task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

model.population_law: Independent draws from bounded continuous marginals joined by a Gaussian copula.
model.transport: Directly transport the reported source anemia fraction, ferritin-deficiency fraction and ferritin geometric mean to the target complete-measurement domain. This is an explicit working assumption, not an identified source-to-target adjustment.

ferritin.conditional_family: The log-distance from the cutoff is half-normal, truncated at the corresponding support endpoint.
ferritin.above_scale_rule: Solve the population log-mean equation so that exp(E[log(ferritin)]) equals 17.4.

dependence.status: ASSUMED; no joint or continuous association estimate was supplied.
